description: Search the UK licensed insolvency practitioners listed on the Insolvency Service "Find an insolvency practitioner" register. Filter by name or firm, town or postcode start, and authorising body. Returns name, firm, town, postcode, IP number, authorising body and a link to the official record (contact details are on that record). Read-only.

body.description: Match on authorising body, e.g. "ICAEW", "Insolvency Practitioners Association".

query.description: Match on practitioner name or firm.

town.description: Match on town, or the start of a postcode (e.g. "LS1").

name: search_insolvency_practitioners
title: Search insolvency practitioners
